best_match.fbbt_definition: A neuron that is part of the adult nervous system. These can be born during the postembryonic phase of neurogenesis (Lacin and Truman, 2016) or they can develop from larval neurons during the pupal stage (Veverytsa and Allan, 2013).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00047095 'adult neuron', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
